text: The new compact RTU series SICAM A8000 CP-8010/12 is based on the SICAM 8 platform. Used in low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear, it is optimized for controlling and monitoring power distribution, i.e. as distribution grid automation. The Snap‑On RGB Display CM‑8880 enables local access to diagnostic and status information as well as simple on‑site operations.
heading: Why SICAM A8000 CP-8010/12?
